name: Haus Langpohl-Maan
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Haus Langpohl-Maan is situated on Austraße in Rum, quietly positioned where the Inn Valley meets the Karwendel Nature Park. This spacious self-catering accommodation features a well-appointed kitchen, comfortable bedrooms, and a welcoming alpine atmosphere highlighted by classic wood furnishings. Excellent public transport links allow guests to reach Innsbruck's historic old town and famous sights such as the Golden Roof within minutes. At the same time, scenic hiking trails and mountain bike routes into the Nordkette mountain range begin practically outside the door. Local grocery stores, bakeries, and authentic Tyrolean eateries are located within easy walking distance in Rum.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday apartment in Rum near Innsbruck featuring a fully equipped kitchen and quick access to the Karwendel Nature Park.
